02 · Behavioral contracts

Rules behind the controls

AutosaveShow dirty, saving, saved, and failed states without blocking work.
SupersedeCreate a new value and preserve the old one with author, time, and reason.
Carry forwardAttach provenance and keep original wording available.
SkipRequire a reason and keep the stage visible in the route.
ConcludeLock normal editing but preserve reading, export, and reopen.
UndoPrefer reversible actions over confirmation dialogs.
ValidationExplain what is missing and why the decision cannot yet be recorded.
Keyboard⌘ K search, ⌘ S save, arrow navigation where ordered.
OfflineKeep local edits visible and identify what has not synchronized.
ConflictShow competing versions and ask for an explicit resolution.
03 · Agent handoff

Behavior brief

Implement behavior as explicit product contracts. - Edit: mark the case dirty without losing the last saved state. - Save: show saving, saved, and failed states. - Supersede: append a new value; preserve the old value, author, date, and rationale. - Carry forward: attach source stage and original wording. - Skip: require a reason; keep the stage visible and marked skipped. - Conclude: lock normal editing, preserve export and reopen. - Reopen: append a reopening event and restore controlled editing. - Prefer undo over modal confirmation for reversible actions. - Validation messages must state what is missing and why it matters. - All meaningful actions append an audit-log event.
